objective: Re-run the exact ordinary Tribal House material that blocked Phase 9 v1 and determine whether the v2 spectral-comb analyzer now produces a defensible untouched grid for real DJ use.

source_identity.known_context: constant-tempo Tribal House material expected around 128 BPM

setup: Require python bootstrap.py -> LIBERTAS BOOT: PASS.
Run npm install && npm run check.
Use the same byte-identical Tribal House WAV(s) from INTELLIGENCE-T5-001; verify SHA-256 before analysis.
Use the tiny headed Codex/Chromium browser and normal physical audio path.
analyzer_gate: Analyze the same WAV on Deck A twice and the duplicate WAV on Deck B once.
Record provider, BPM, tempoConfidence, firstBeatFrame/seconds, phaseConfidence, gridConfidence, recommended, and the complete tempoCandidates diagnostics.
Record diagnostics.legacyTempoBpm and diagnostics.legacyTempoConfidence so F-0016 remains visible.
Require deterministic repeat: BPM/anchor/provenance stable within analyzer resolution.
Require duplicate agreement for the byte-identical second WAV.
Confirm analysis alone does not mutate the existing manual grids.
Do not manually type 128 BPM, repair firstBeatFrame, or alter confidence.
If recommended=false, or if the proposal remains musically implausible for this ~128 BPM material, STOP and report BLOCKED.
apply_and_sync_only_if_gate_passes: Explicitly Apply the untouched v2 proposal to A and B.
Load the ordinary WAV into both decks.
Start both decks and enable SYNC with A as leader.
Run ordinary-program-material SYNC for at least 3 minutes.
Capture phase error, sync lock/tracking, follower rate, transportSeekCount, frame discontinuities, stale snapshots, and mixer discontinuities at start and end.
Exercise one explicit follower Hot Cue or jog and verify SYNC re-locks without hidden corrective seeks.
Obtain human audible confirmation that the ordinary tracks are aligned and remain aligned, with no abnormal clicks/dropouts.

pass_requirements.analyzer: Untouched v2 proposal must be recommended and plausibly near the track's known ~128 BPM pulse; deterministic and duplicate-stable.
pass_requirements.grid_authority: No mutation before explicit Apply; no manual repair.
pass_requirements.ordinary_track_sync: At least 3 minutes locked/tracking with no hidden corrective seek and no new A/B/mixer discontinuities.
pass_requirements.audible: Human confirms the ordinary track pair is actually heard in sync.

report_rules: Return PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED with exact raw v2 diagnostics.
Preserve the old v1 144.5839 failure in history.
